result: PASS for candidate; coordinator must update master placement/linking and reopen the master before marking finished

criteria.name: identity_and_footprint
criteria.rationale: Official Purdue BuildingShapes FID 649 identifies WDCT and Purdue ownership. The feature's 81.63 x 46.62 m projected outline is reconstructed from the returned geometry; the candidate has 0.9959 polygon IoU, with maximum axis-aligned bounds differences of about 0.016 m. Adjacency to Wiley Hall corroborates identity. Esri Shape__Area disagrees with area calculated from the returned ring, so the ring, not that field, was used. GIS is not a surveyed wall survey.

criteria.name: position_orientation_and_dimensions
criteria.rationale: The asset geometry is local to the proposed centroid (-597.574, 124.804) m with identity root transform. The structural shell fits the FID ring and long axis is nearly east-west. Master manifest still marks the asset as massing/world-coordinate; a Placement marker and master reopen are required. The local tangent transform is approximate, not survey control.

criteria.name: height_and_roof_form
criteria.rationale: A tall central gabled dining volume with lower side wings is supported by Purdue and architect images. One-story-plus-basement is supported by FRP; the GIS reports three levels, and its height-like fields have no documented units. Modeled 6.15 m eaves, 10.85 m ridge and 11.55 m crest are estimates; basement is not modeled.

criteria.name: exterior_facade_and_materials
criteria.rationale: Brick, limestone bands/piers, large dark-framed glazing, gable, metal roof, secondary openings and roof equipment are present and recognizable. Twelve node materials cover the exterior/interior without external file dependencies. In previews the façade reads quite dark and stylized, brick relief/detail is subtle, and window/wing placement is generalized relative to the reference photos.

criteria.name: interior_modularity_and_evidence
criteria.rationale: Fresh Blender 5.2.3 open confirms the expected 1,054-object collection, including 1,053 meshes; every mesh has a material, and the source file has no external images. The layout contains dining tables/chairs, a ring of serving counters, tiled circulation, exposed timber ceiling/trusses and pendants, all program features supported by Purdue sources. The cutaway preview is dim and the repeated furniture is blocky/simple compared with the real photos; exact room layout and furniture placement are not documented or measured. Overall interior should be treated as schematic.

sources_reviewed.limitation: Shape__Area conflicts with recomputed returned-ring area; geometry used.

sources_reviewed.use: Building location south of Wiley Hall, freestanding 500-seat dining court; brick exterior, large windows, vaulted wood ceiling, glass/steel/tile.
Single-story with basement and 500 seats; project-image gallery reviewed for exterior and interior features.

findings: The candidate meets the 8/10 threshold for coordinator integration, with strong identity and GIS footprint fit.

Do not mark finished until the shared manifest is converted from campus-world massing bounds to local detailed geometry at (-597.574,124.804) m, its Placement marker is built, and the assembled master is reopened and checked for duplicates and contextual fit.
Keep height and the GIS level/height-field discrepancy explicitly estimated/unresolved; the basement is not modeled.
The interior is a plausible schematic program representation rather than a measured room-by-room reconstruction; its lighting and furniture detail are visibly weaker than the reference imagery.
